personal.name: Abhay Madaan
personal.title: Generative AI Engineer | Python & Full Stack Developer
personal.bio:
Hey 👋
I'm Abhay, a Generative AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 2+ years building production AI systems in Python. I design RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and multimodal search using LangChain, LangGraph, and HuggingFace, and I ship scalable backends with Node.js, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. I love turning LLM research into real, production-grade products.

current.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
current.institution: Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Ludhiana

experience.description: Develop and maintain high-scale iGaming platforms using Node.js, BullMQ, Redis, and PostgreSQL, optimizing public APIs via query tuning and caching to reduce p95 response times by 35%. Delivered business-critical features including VIP Levels, Campaign Management, Bonus Systems, and Race Engine within a 10-engineer team on a platform serving 10,000+ average daily active users. Concurrently building AI-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph, RAG pipelines, Weaviate, Groq (Llama 3.3 70B), and CLIP for multimodal search and product recommendations.

Developed scalable full-stack applications using Node.js, React.js, React Native, and PostgreSQL across multiple business domains. Reduced backend response time by up to 70% through query optimization, caching, and asynchronous workflow implementation. Integrated Stripe payment gateway with secure webhook validation and complete payment lifecycle handling.

projects.title: UrFitAI - AI Fashion Discovery Platform
projects.description: Engineered a RAG pipeline using LangChain and Groq (Llama 3.3 70B), retrieving semantically matched products from Weaviate via CLIP and sentence-transformer embeddings for grounded, product-aware styling recommendations. Built an AI virtual try-on feature integrating IDM-VTON (HuggingFace Spaces) with async background job architecture, Cloudinary storage, and real-time polling. Built a configurable Scrapy/Selenium scraping pipeline with stealth patching and JSONB-driven selectors, cataloging 100,000+ products across multiple brands for NLP-based product matching.

projects.title: AI Agent Platform - Multi-Agent Research Assistant
projects.description: Implemented a multi-agent research assistant using LangGraph with supervisor-routed orchestration across 3 specialized agents (Researcher, Writer, Reviewer) and tool calling for automated web search. Configured multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI, Anthropic) with runtime switching, and an iterative writer-reviewer refinement loop (up to 3 revision cycles) with human-in-the-loop review checkpoints. Containerized the application with Docker for reproducible deployment.

projects.title: Betski - iGaming Platform
projects.description: Collaborated within a 10-engineer team to develop core platform features (VIP Levels, Campaign Management, Bonus Systems, Race Engine), reducing public API latency by up to 80% through query tuning and Redis caching on a platform serving 10,000+ average daily active users. Built a fake-bet detection feature to flag fraudulent betting activity in real time, protecting platform revenue and supporting the owner's fundraising efforts. Secured public-facing APIs against a live exploit attack using Cloudflare WAF rules. Scaled BullMQ background job processing across containerized workers on AWS Docker/ECS.

projects.title: Ready Taxi - Ride-Hailing Platform
projects.description: Architected a multi-role platform (customers, drivers, dispatchers, fleet operators) with JWT-based RBAC, implementing real-time trip tracking, dynamic driver allocation, and live ride updates via Socket.IO. Implemented a dynamic driver-search algorithm that progressively widens the search radius and relaxes matching filters as wait time increases, improving driver-match success in low-availability zones.
